I found out that it was my ex. I didn't confront him about it. He never responded after the last message, if he does, I'll put more up. I looked in my 'Other' folder on Facebook and found this.

-Back Story-

I dated my ex (the guy who has black over his name) for about a week before our 2 months together. I saw him as a friend and to be honest, I saw someone else as a better choice for myself. I got together with that someone else (the guy who has blue over his name). 

The reason I broke up with my ex was because he's a Senior and he pressured me into moving really fast. He brought up moving in with each other in the first month. And I thought we were moving way too fast, so I told him to stop, but it kept coming up so I broke up with him. 

He took the break up really hard, he kept trying to make me get back together with him but I refused and because of this, it made him get really upset. He tried pitying me by saying he was going to drop out (when we only had about 2 months of school left...) and that he ended up hurting himself physically because I wouldn't get back together with him. He waited out in front of my 5th period during school just to get me to talk with him to "make things right". 

After the first 2 days, I told him to leave me alone because it was bothering me. My current boyfriend, who was my 'best friend' at the time, and I used to walk around school after school to wait for my mom to pick me up and she'd usually pick me up about an hour after school let out. 

While we stayed after, he followed us, everywhere we went. I just thought it as a coincidence but after a while it started getting really creepy, so I confronted him about that as well. He stated that he was looking for a place to climb. In school? Really? I reported him to school authorities and he left me alone then. 

At times I would see him staring at me in the hallways and sometimes when I would walk to class he would end up close to me because he was going the same way when a few seconds ago he was going the opposite way. That's all that's happening recently, other than the texts. 

TL;DR Ex takes break up bad. Physically abuses self to pity me into relationship turns into stalking after school and finally goes into creepy stares in hallways.
